title: Assyrian branch settles the 'old Holy Land' and is later destroyed

tellings.quote: I believe a branch of the Assyrians that moved into what I'm calling this old Holy Land

plain: A branch of the Assyrians, the ancient people of Mesopotamia, moved into what he calls an "old Holy Land" in eastern Turkey and was later destroyed there, according to the researcher Matt LaCroix. LaCroix offers it to Jesse Michels as his own belief, without naming a source, in an episode about a great event he places around 12,000 BC.
